core.why: This age group is most likely to try new menu items and engage with local, experiential offerings like a special drink paired with a 'come say hi' event. They are active in local social scenes and value unique, time-limited promotions.

spillover.why: These groups may still be within walking distance or car reach, especially if they are local residents or frequent visitors to South Congress. While less likely to be the primary target, they are not excluded by proximity or interest in local events.

decision.headline: Launch B: it leads by 4.4 points and is 69% likely to be the better version. A sharper Version C could widen the gap.
reasons: B leads on intent to visit: 24.4% vs 20.0%, a 4.4-point gap with a 95% interval of ±17.2 points, and B is ahead in 1 of 1 seeds. B is 69% likely to be the better version.
A live split test would need about 1,376 people per version (10.2% of the local Instagram users) and paid impressions to detect this gap. Ripple ran it on the simulated crowd for $0 of ad spend.
There are about 27,006 Instagram users in Austin, TX 78704 (Census x Pew join).
A sharper Version C, drafted from what people objected to, could widen the gap. It is worth acting on only if it moves intent by at least 3.3 points, the smallest gap that would be worth acting on.
